apparel.notes: Apparel items can be returned within 30 days even if opened, provided they are unused.

electronics.notes: Electronics must be unopened. Opened items require manual review.

home.notes: Home items can be returned within 14 days if in usable condition.

final_sale.notes: Final sale items are not eligible for returns.

damaged_on_arrival.notes: Items damaged on arrival are eligible for full refund within 7 days.

late_delivery.notes: Late deliveries are compensated with store credit.
